hints.title: Bitmask Grid Representation
hints.text: Since the grid has at most 15 cells (m * n <= 15), encode the grid state as a 15-bit integer.

hints.title: Row and Column Clearing Mask
hints.text: Choosing cell (r, c) clears all ones in row r and column c.

hints.title: Shortest Path Search
hints.text: Use breadth-first search on bitmask states to find the minimum number of clearing steps to reach state zero.

hints.title: Complete Python Solution

complexity.time: O(2^(M*N) * M * N) breadth-first search over bitmask states
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Trying all sequences without state caching explores duplicate subgrids exponentially.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: 2^15 = 32768 states allows complete BFS exploration in milliseconds.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize small dimensions and apply bitmask BFS shortest path.

solutions.approach: C++ bitmask BFS with boolean visited array.
JavaScript BFS with Uint8Array visited table.
